# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Comprehensive bilingual dictionary providing English-French translations with definitions, usage examples, and phrase translations from Cambridge University Press.

Cambridge Dictionary offers authoritative translations powered by multiple lexicographic sources including the PASSWORD English-French Dictionary, GLOBAL English-French Dictionary, and corpora such as the Cambridge English Corpus and Europarl Parallel Corpus. The platform serves language learners and translators with detailed word definitions, idiomatic expressions, and real-world usage examples across multiple registers and domains.
